method: Sample moments of the 137 verified 2026 finals. Mean and SD are what a normal-approximation line is priced from; the quantiles are the same information without assuming normality. sd_used_for_pricing is the sample SD (ddof=1).

normal_check.note: Excess kurtosis ~0 means a normal approximation is not crazy; large negative values mean the distribution is too flat-peaked for normal pricing to be safe.
